notes.title: Big patch 0.3 is now available!
notes.notes:
This is the next patch, this time a really big one, for M.E.A.T. Veterans. We have managed to eliminate the previous minor bugs, and have instead introduced new features and facilities for players.

As always, you can find details of the fixed, new and removed elements in our News Hub.

And don't forget that we still encourage you to give us feedback - we are interested in your opinions, comments and suggestions. Record your games and share them on social media!

notes.title: TIPS & TRICKS: How to move faster around the map?
notes.notes:
[h2]We're launching the first part of our new 'Tips and Tricks' series, through which we'll be sharing with you advice on the gameplay of M.E.A.T. Veterans. 

We start with information on the speed of movement in the game. Ready for your first lesson?[/h2]

[h3]1. Speed depends on the weapon you choose[/h3]

Depending on which weapon you choose, this is how efficiently you will be able to move. You will move fastest when holding a tomahawk, revolver, dynamite or Molotov cocktail. The slowest is with a minigun.

[h3]2. Why slide around the map?[/h3]

If, when jumping, you press the crouch button on landing, your character will perform a slide. Why is it worth using it? First of all, sliding will make it much harder for your opponents - they will have trouble hitting your character. What's more, the slide will allow you to move more quickly through selected areas of the map. It's also a great element of surprise when you decide to run out from behind a wall straight at a possible opponent.

[h3]3. How to make a good bunny hop?[/h3]

A bunny hop will enable you to move around the map in the most efficient way. To do this, press the run and jump keys at the same time, taking care to maintain the correct direction. However, if you land incorrectly or change direction in the middle of a move, your character will grossly slow down instead of moving faster. Practice for a while and you'll find that you can quickly master this move to perfection!
